title: Jazz Festival Poster
summary: Large-format typographic festival poster with multi-line lineup, gradient backdrop, and stylized silhouette.
prompt: A large-format typographic poster for a fictional jazz festival. At the top in bold condensed sans-serif: "{argument name="masthead" default="BLUE NOTE SESSIONS"}" in {argument name="masthead color" default="deep navy"}. Below in elegant script: "{argument name="subtitle" default="Summer 2026 — Central Park, New York"}". The poster lists four performers: "{argument name="act 1" default="Miles Ahead Quintet / Saturday 8PM"}" "{argument name="act 2" default="Sarah Chen Trio / Saturday 10PM"}" "{argument name="act 3" default="The Monk Revival / Sunday 7PM"}" "{argument name="act 4" default="Coltrane Legacy Orchestra / Sunday 9PM"}". A stylized {argument name="motif" default="golden saxophone"} silhouette runs vertically along the right edge. Background is a gradient from {argument name="gradient top" default="midnight blue"} to {argument name="gradient bottom" default="warm amber"}. At the bottom in small caps: "{argument name="footer" default="Tickets at bluenote.nyc — All ages welcome"}".
